{{Short description|French biologist and physicist}}
'''Eva Pebay-Peyroula''' (born 1956) is a French [[biologist]] and [[physicist]]. She studies the functions of [[membrane protein]]s and in particular [[Membrane transport protein|membrane transporters]].

== Biography ==

=== Studies ===
Eva Pebay-Peyroula studied at  [[Lycée Stendhal]] in [[Grenoble]], where she developed an interest in science. She then enrolled in the [[Classe préparatoire aux grandes écoles|preparatory classes]] for the "Grandes Écoles". She initially pursued [[meteorology]] and enrolled in a school to study this field, but later shifted to physics at the University of Grenoble-Alpes, earning a master's degree. In 1979, she obtained her agrégation in physics and taught for two years at a high school in [[Nîmes|Nimes]].<ref name="CNRS">{{cite web |date=December 2005 |title=médaille d'argent 2005 (p. 33) |url=http://www.cnrs.fr/sites/default/files/download-file/2005argent_web_12.pdf |access-date=10 March 2019 |website=[[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] |language=fr |publication-date=}}</ref> She then completed a "[[Master of Advanced Studies|Diplome d'études approfondies]]" (DEA) on the interaction between radiation and matter and decided to turn to research. She did her doctoral research in [[atomic physics]] at the Laboratoire national des champs magnétiques intense under the direction of Rémy Jost. In 1986, she defended her doctoral thesis on [[Glyoxal|ethanedial]] at [[Joseph Fourier University|Joseph-Fourier University]].<ref>{{cite web |date=23 December 2016 |title=Eva Pebay-Peroula : un parcours original, de la physique atomique à la biologie structurale |url=https://www.refletsdelaphysique.fr/articles/refdp/pdf/2016/04/refdp201651p42.pdf |access-date=10 March 2019 |website=Reflets de la physique |language=fr |publication-date=}}</ref>

=== Career ===
After her thesis, she obtained a position as a research fellow at the CNRS at the Laue-Langevin Institute. In 1989, she was appointed lecturer at Joseph-Fourier University. In 1992, she joined the Institute of [[Structural biology|Structural Biology]]. In 1994 she obtained a university degree and became a professor in 1995 at the University of Grenoble-Alpes.<ref name="academia">{{cite web|title=Prof. Dr. Eva Pebay-Peyroula|url=http://www.academia-net.org/profil/prof-dr-eva-pebay-peyroula/1403562|website=Academia|language=fr|date=December 2005|access-date=10 March 2019|publication-date=}}</ref> In 2001, she created the membrane protein laboratory at the Institute of Structural Biology. From 2004 to 2014, she was director of this institute. In May 2010, she was appointed chairman of the board of directors of the National Research Agency (ANR).<ref>{{cite web|title=Nominations du mois|url=https://www.larecherche.fr/nominations-du-mois-7|website=La Recherche|language=fr|date=July–August 2010|access-date=10 March 2019|publication-date=}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Eva Pebay-Peyroula à la tête de l'Agence de la recherche (ANR)|url=http://www.ibs.fr/recherche/faits-marquants/archives/2010/article/eva-pebay-peyroula-a-la-tete-de-l|website=IBS|language=fr|date=2010|access-date=10 March 2019|publication-date=}}</ref> She held this position until 2012. She has been a member of the Strategic Research Council since 2014.<ref>[http://legifrance.gouv.fr/affichTexte.do?cidTexte=JORFTEXT000028558434 « Décret du 3 février 2014 portant nomination au Conseil stratégique de la recherche »], [[Journal officiel de la République française|''JORF'']] No.&nbsp;30 du 5 février 2014, p. 2100, texte No.&nbsp;41, [[Système NOR|NOR]] ESRR1330003D</ref>

=== Family ===
She is married and has three children.<ref name="academia" />

== Positions and awards ==
*1994 to 1999: junior member of the [[Institut Universitaire de France|Institut universitaire de France]]<ref name="académie">{{cite web|title=C.V. de Eva Pebay-Peyroula - Membre de l'Académie des sciences|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/pdf/membre/PebayPeyroulaE_bio170510.pdf|website=Académie des Sciences|language=fr|date=17 May 2010|access-date=10 March 2019|publication-date=}}</ref>
*30 November 2004: election to the French Academy of Sciences<ref>{{cite web|title=Eva Pebay-Peyroula|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-P/eva-pebay-peyroula.html|website=Académie des Sciences|language=fr|access-date=10 March 2019|date=}}</ref>
*2005: CNRS silver medal<ref name="CNRS" /><ref>{{cite web|title=Eva Pebay-Peyroula reçoit la médaille d'argent du CNRS|url=http://www.alpes.cnrs.fr/UserFiles/File/15medias/CP/CP_medArg_PebayPeyroula.pdf|website=CNRS|language=fr|date=2 June 2006|access-date=10 March 2019|publication-date=|archive-date=21 November 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151121024007/http://www.alpes.cnrs.fr/UserFiles/File/15medias/CP/CP_medArg_PebayPeyroula.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*2006: Senior member of the Institut universitaire de France<ref name="académie" />
*2007: Chevalier of the [[Ordre national de la Légion d'Honneur]] National Order of the Legion of Honour<ref name="ordre">{{cite web|title=Décret du 25 mars 2016 portant promotion et nomination|url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/affichTexte.do?cidTexte=JORFTEXT000032295678|language=fr|date=27 March 2016|access-date=10 March 2019|publication-date=}}</ref>
*2016: Officer of the Ordre national de la Légion d'Honneur<ref name="ordre" />
